<?php
class TypedGetReceptionHistory {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool {
        echo "I:", $incoming, ";";
        $incoming = "isset-formal";
        $GLOBALS["name"] = "changed";
        $GLOBALS["o"] = null;
        return true;
    }
    public function __get(string $incoming) {
        echo "G:", $incoming, ";";
        $incoming = 9;
        return 0;
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo "D;"; }
}
$name = "";
$o = new TypedGetReceptionHistory;
echo ($o->$name ?? 9) === 0 ? "ZERO;" : "BAD;";
echo $name === "changed" ? "CHANGED;" : "BAD;";
echo $o === null ? "NULL;" : "BAD;";

<?php
function typed_get_rhs(): int { echo "BADRHS;"; return 9; }
class TypedGetAssignment {
    private int $yes = 100;
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I:", $incoming, ";"; return true; }
    public function __get(string $incoming) { echo "G:", $incoming, ";"; return 7; }
    public function __set(string $incoming, $value): void { echo "BADSET;"; }
}
$o = new TypedGetAssignment;
echo ($o->yes ??= typed_get_rhs()) === 7 ? "KEEP;" : "BAD;";
